# Recipe Found: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Chili

**Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/sweet-potato-and-black-bean-chili-recipe-229448 (Allrecipes)

## Qualification Check
- ✅ **Vegetarian:** Yes
- ✅ **Rating:** 4.8 stars (≥4 stars required)
- ✅ **Reviews:** 472 ratings, 358 reviews (≥50 required)
- ✅ **High-Protein:** Two 15-oz cans of black beans provide ~30g of plant protein per batch, plus sweet potatoes and dairy (sour cream garnish)

## Cooking Time
- **Prep Time:** 20 minutes
- **Cook Time:** 1 hour 10 minutes
- **Total Time:** 1 hour 30 minutes
- **Servings:** 4

## Ingredient List
1. 2 pounds orange-fleshed sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes
2. ½ teaspoon ground dried chipotle pepper
3. ½ teaspoon salt
4. 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided
5. 1 onion, diced
6. 4 cloves garlic, minced
7. 1 red bell pepper, diced
8. 1 jalapeño pepper, sliced
9. 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder (or to taste)
10. 1 tablespoon ground cumin
11. ¼ teaspoon dried oregano
12. 1 (28 ounce) can diced tomatoes
13. 1 cup water (or more as needed)
14. 1 tablespoon cornmeal
15. 1 teaspoon salt (or to taste)
16. 1 teaspoon white sugar
17. 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder
18. 2 (15 ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained
19. 1 pinch cayenne pepper (or to taste)
20. ½ cup sour cream, for garnish (optional)
21. ¼ cup chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish (optional)

## Brief Cooking Steps
1. **Prep & Roast:** Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment. Toss sweet potatoes with chipotle pepper, ½ tsp salt, and 1 Tbsp olive oil; spread on the sheet and roast 20–25 minutes until crisp outside and tender inside. Cool to room temperature.

2. **Sauté Aromatics:** In a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat, cook the remaining 1 Tbsp olive oil with onion, garlic, red bell pepper, jalapeño, ancho chile powder, cumin, and oregano for about 5 minutes until the onion softens.

3. **Build the Base:** Add diced tomatoes and water; bring to a simmer. Stir in cornmeal, 1 tsp salt, sugar, and cocoa powder. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

4. **Combine & Finish:** Stir in the black beans and roasted sweet potatoes. Add extra water if too thick and simmer ~15 minutes more until heated through. Season with salt and cayenne. Serve topped with sour cream and cilantro.
